dialogue.villagium.gentle.weather.respon: The weather is quite pleasant today, isn't it?
I do hope this nice weather lasts!
dialogue.villagium.gentle.joke.response1: Oh, that's a good one! Hehe.
dialogue.villagium.gentle.joke.response2: You have a fine sense of humor!
dialogue.villagium.gentle.local_news.res: I haven't heard much, but the village seems peaceful.
Did you hear about old Man Willow's cat? Quite the adventurer!
dialogue.villagium.gentle.hobbies.respon: I enjoy a bit of quiet reading when I can.
Tending to my small garden brings me joy.
dialogue.villagium.gentle.ask_how_feelin: I'm doing quite well, thank you for asking!
Feeling rather content today, the sun is lovely.
dialogue.villagium.gentle.fallback.respo: Hmm, I'm not sure what to say to that.
dialogue.villagium.player_initiate_promp: What would you like to talk about?
dialogue.villagium.category_topics_promp: Select a specific topic to discuss:
dialogue.villagium.local_news.intro: I heard something interesting happened near the town square recently.
dialogue.villagium.local_news.rumors_res: They say a strange merchant was spotted trading rare glowing ores!
dialogue.villagium.local_news.dismissed_: Hmph, suit yourself. It's your loss.
dialogue.villagium.hobbies.studious_resp: I spend most of my time reading ancient scrolls and archives.
dialogue.villagium.hobbies.generic_respo: I like wood carving and taking quiet walks in the forest.
dialogue.villagium.hobbies.mining_reacti: Oh! Fascinating. Finding hidden treasures in the deep dark must be thrilling!
dialogue.villagium.hobbies.recommend_rea: You should read 'The Rise of Villagium'. It has magnificent illustrations!
dialogue.villagium.feelings.angry_respon: I'm not in the mood to discuss my feelings right now. Please leave me be.
dialogue.villagium.feelings.happy_respon: I feel absolutely wonderful today! Thank you so much for asking.
dialogue.villagium.feelings.generic_resp: I'm doing alright, just going about my usual daily tasks.
dialogue.villagium.feelings.cheer_reacti: Heh, thank you. That actually brought a smile to my face!
dialogue.villagium.feelings.good_day_rea: Thank you! I hope you have a great day too.
dialogue.villagium.weather.sunny_happy: What a beautiful sunny day! It puts me in a great mood.
dialogue.villagium.weather.sunny_generic: The weather is quite nice today.
dialogue.villagium.weather.happy_bye: It was nice chatting with you! Enjoy the weather.
dialogue.villagium.weather.angry_bye: Hmph. We clearly don't see eye to eye.
dialogue.villagium.joke.intro_angry: What do you want? I'm not in the mood for jokes.
dialogue.villagium.joke.intro: Got a good joke for me today?
dialogue.villagium.joke.reaction_angry: Why are you ignoring me? How rude!
dialogue.villagium.food.gentle_intro: I always enjoy a quiet moment to prepare a warm meal. Do you have a favorite food?
dialogue.villagium.food.gluttony_intro: Oh! Speaking of food... my stomach is growling! What kind of delicious food do you like?
dialogue.villagium.food.generic_intro: Food is one of life's simple pleasures, isn't it? What kind of dishes do you prefer?
dialogue.villagium.choice.breakfast: Ask what they ate for breakfast
dialogue.villagium.food.gentle_sweets: Sweet pastries are so lovely... I enjoy baking them to share with everyone in the village.
dialogue.villagium.food.gluttony_sweets: YES! Cakes, cookies, pies, chocolate... I can never get enough of them! I want to eat them all day!
dialogue.villagium.food.generic_sweets: Sweets are nice for a little energy boost. A fresh cookie is always welcome.
dialogue.villagium.food.gentle_breakfast: I had a warm, gentle herbal tea and fresh toasted bread. It is a peaceful way to start the morning.
dialogue.villagium.food.generic_breakfas: Just a standard quick meal to get ready for the day's chores.
